verdict.rationale: Instinct's own marketing says it is "trained to use a phone and a computer" and connects to the "screen" among other device surfaces, and it ships a Mac OS app, so desktop computer-use is a documented product claim. However, there is no detailed documentation of how it sees or operates local applications, and community reports cover email, calls, booking and purchases rather than driving desktop apps. One user's attempt to use it with Obsidian and GitHub stalled on credential handling. Missing for 10: documented mechanics of screen viewing and app control, scope and permission details for operating local apps, and hands-on corroboration of it completing work inside desktop applications.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
